matchInput: I want to start a business
aliases: I want to start my own business
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Engage a company-registration specialist for legal setup
steps.why: Registration and tax paperwork should be handled with an appropriate professional from the start. This step names the professional type only — it is not advice.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for logo and brand identity
steps.why: The brand comes before photos and web work so nothing has to be redone. The logo gets reused across signage, packaging, and social media.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for product or premises photos
steps.why: Quality photos are the base assets for the website and social channels, and one shoot after the brand is set covers both.

steps.title: Hire a web developer for a basic website
steps.why: A simple site gives customers a way to find and trust the business, using the brand and photos already created.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for Facebook and Instagram
steps.why: Consistent posting builds an audience from launch. Starting after brand and photos are ready makes the feed coherent from day one.
